findings.charge: The join measures the DR-126 remainder into six obligations across four buckets, but omits the traveling-honesty class that the very decision it is built on expressly created. D-125 records four advisories as travelling honesty work on this row. The artifact contains no obligation for them, no honesty bucket, and no mention of an advisory anywhere.
evidence: D-125's Decision paragraph, in live COORD, reads: 'Claude advisories CLAUDE-V45-A1 / CLAUDE-V45-A2 / CLAUDE-V45-A3 and Claude D-000 advisory CLAUDE-D125-A1 travel as honesty work.' The join cites D-125 as its foundation and takes the leftover-T2-02 and dual-ACCEPT limbs from that same decision.

All four advisories are live: CLAUDE-V45-A1, A2 and A3 are present in the advisories array of platform-tcb-contract.v45.review-independent.claude2.json, and CLAUDE-D125-A1 is present in coordinator-decisions.D-125.review-adversarial.claude2.json.

Searched the subject for 'advis', 'honesty' and 'Honesty': zero occurrences of each. The six obligation ids are OBL-CONTRACT-V45, OBL-G22-HARNESS-SPEC, OBL-G22-FX-AUTHORING, OBL-G22-EXECUTION, OBL-RESERVED-TABLES and OBL-G07-BOUNDARY, none of which carries them.

summary's classification buckets are leftoverDesign, recordedCandidateNotApplied, qualificationAtNamedGate and deferredOrRidesElsewhere. There is no honesty bucket, so the category itself is absent rather than present and empty.

Both leftover-joins already ADOPTED in this corpus carry the class explicitly. permission-leftover-join.v2, recorded at D-163, has OBL-ADVISORY-HONESTY reading 'D-042 advisories P2-01/P2-02/P2-03/PT2-CX-A1 remain owed as honesty work … Honesty work is not leftover-design and is not SATISFIED', plus a honesty bucket in summary. doctor-actor-leftover-join.v2, recorded at D-164, has the same shape naming D-035 advisories A1-A6 and the D-127 and D-129 traveling advisories.
findings.whyThisIsNotPedantry: Traveling honesty is precisely the class that is easy to lose. It is not leftover-design, not SATISFIED, and rides no gate, so unless a join names it, nothing on the row carries it forward — which is why both adopted siblings name theirs. A coordinator recording this join would take the DR-126 remainder as fully measured at six obligations, and the four advisories D-125 said travel would have no carrier on the row's ledger.
refutationAttempted: Argue the artifact is scoped to leftover-design only, so a non-leftover class is legitimately out of scope. This fails on the artifact's own shape: three of its four buckets are non-leftover — recordedCandidateNotApplied, qualificationAtNamedGate and deferredOrRidesElsewhere — and four of its six obligations carry leftoverDesign false. It is a full remainder measurement, not a leftover-only list, so the one non-leftover class it omits is not omitted by scope.

Argue the advisories remain recorded at D-125 regardless, so nothing is lost. True, and it is why this is a SHOULD-FIX rather than a blocker: the artifact asserts nothing false and none of its six classifications is wrong. But a join exists so the row's remainder can be read in one place, and the adopted siblings set the standard that traveling advisories are read there too.
findings.whatWouldLandIt: Add an OBL-ADVISORY-HONESTY obligation with leftoverDesign false and rideStanding honesty, naming CLAUDE-V45-A1, CLAUDE-V45-A2, CLAUDE-V45-A3 and CLAUDE-D125-A1 as travelling honesty work per D-125, and add the corresponding honesty bucket to summary — the shape permission-leftover-join.v2 and doctor-actor-leftover-join.v2 already carry.

verdictStatement: REJECT at 0 blockers and 1 SHOULD-FIX. The artifact is otherwise strong and I want that recorded. All fifteen cited digest pairs measure equal with zero mismatches; recordedInputs.HEAD, the top-level head and live HEAD all agree, satisfying the artifact's own remeasurement invariant; namedCorpusNotAuthored is == exact to live G22 v1 at one class and matches the live DR-G22 harness cell; every claim quoted from v45 and G22 v1 was located in those artifacts' live bytes, including g22.namingStanding, the two whatThisDoesNotDo lines, filesystems.standing RESERVED, matrixStanding INCOMPLETE, versionOrBuildSelector RESERVED with requiredBeforeAllowlistFreeze true, and the leftoverNameNote that makes this artifact's self-description as the later leftover-join accurate; D-125 checks out as dual ACCEPT 0/0 with both verdict digests equal; the two subjects are CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED and bind NOTHING; DR-126 leftover-design is not claimed closed, v45 is not applied, no reserved table or selector is populated, no DR-G* row is added, required-now is 26, and the subject did not move. It falls on one gap. D-125, the decision this join is built on, records four advisories that 'travel as honesty work' on DR-126, and the join has no obligation for them, no honesty bucket, and no occurrence of the word advisory or honesty anywhere. Both leftover-joins already adopted in this corpus carry exactly that class. Traveling honesty rides no gate and is not leftover-design, so a join that omits it leaves it with no carrier on the row.
